briefdescription.para: Initialize a mutex in unlocked state.

simplesect.para: SYN_OK on success, or SYN_INVALID_PARAM if mutex is NULL.

briefdescription.para: Attempt to acquire the mutex without blocking.

detaileddescription.para: If the mutex is already locked by another task and task has higher priority (numerically lower value) than the owner, the owner's priority is automatically boosted.

simplesect.para: Single-scheduler (AMP) scope: all scheduled tasks (task->sched != NULL) acquiring or contending on a mutex must belong to the same SYN_Sched instance (SYN_INVALID_PARAM otherwise). Use syn_port_spinlock.h or SPSC syn_mailbox across AMP cores.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to acquiring task (optional, NULL for standalone lock).

simplesect.para: SYN_OK if acquired, SYN_BUSY if held by another task, or SYN_INVALID_PARAM.

briefdescription.para: Probe and acquire the mutex without registering as a contended waiter.

detaileddescription.para: Acquires an unlocked or recursively-held mutex like syn_mutex_try_lock(), but on contention returns SYN_BUSY without adding task to the waiter list or boosting the current owner.

simplesect.para: Single-scheduler (AMP) scope: returns SYN_INVALID_PARAM if contended against a different SYN_Sched instance.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to acquiring task (optional, NULL for standalone lock).

simplesect.para: SYN_OK if acquired, SYN_BUSY if held by another task, or SYN_INVALID_PARAM.

detaileddescription.para: Decrements the recursion count. When the count reaches zero, the owner's priority is restored to its base priority and ownership is cleared.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to owner task releasing the lock.

simplesect.para: SYN_OK on success, SYN_ERROR if not locked or wrong owner, or SYN_INVALID_PARAM.

briefdescription.para: Check if the mutex is currently locked.
Get the current owner of the mutex.

simplesect.para: Pointer to owner task, or NULL if unlocked.
